thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering-service - high error rate and delayed invoice job detected. link: https://logs.redwood.ai/tx/abcd1234
Alex K: on it, checking logs and recent deploys.
Alex K: seeing a flood of 500s from /metering/usage for the hourly job. starting a tail of the job logs.
Maria G: tagging in billing because customers might see 0 usage on dashboard and missing daily invoices. Lina?
Lina (Billing): on standby. which tenants affected? any pattern?
Alex K: initial filter shows reports for customers with usage in EU-region pools and for accounts that had quota churn around 04:00 UTC.
Jordan T: re: deploys - we rolled a change to the metering worker around 03:45 UTC (rev ec9a1f). Could be related.
Samir P: quick note - the invoice queue consumer appears stuck with a backlog. Requeue count = 12k, error rate 15%/min.
Alex K: running a quick grep for exceptions: 
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined
    at computeUsage (/srv/metering-worker/index.js:142)
    at processNext (/srv/metering-worker/queue.js:88)
```

Maria G: not great. If computeUsage throws early, downstream aggregation and invoice generation will skip customers => dashboards show 0 and invoices delayed.
Lina (Billing): customers on monthly billing will be unaffected for charges but they will get delayed statements. We need to notify any customers with outstanding invoices > $5k? recommend targeted comms.
Emily C: Support is already getting DMs. We need a short status page entry and a customer-facing note. I'll draft.
Ops Oncall: I'll take the pager from here and perform mitigation. Alex, handoff in 2 min with what you've tried.
Alex K: done a restart of one worker instance to see if consumer recovers; partial progress but errors reappeared. I have a runbook open: /runbooks/metering-restarts.
Ops Oncall: rolling back metering-worker to previous release (ec78b4) on a single canary node now. Will watch queue depth.
incident-bot: Deploy rollback started by Ops Oncall. CI link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876
Jordan T: recommend also pausing invoice scheduler so we don't generate partial/incorrect invoices while we still have a bad state. Command: `kubectl scale deployment/invoice-scheduler --replicas=0`
Ops Oncall: paused scheduler. queue depth stabilizing. errors dropping.
Samir P: reprocessing backlog will be manual. Suggest running reconciliation query to identify customers who saw usage == 0 and their last-ingested event timestamp. SQL snippet: 
```
SELECT tenant_id, MIN(received_ts) as first_missing, COUNT(*) as missing_count
FROM events
WHERE received_ts > now() - interval '12 hours'
  AND source = 'metering-ingest'
  AND usage = 0
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
```

Lina (Billing): good. we'll use that list to target invoice re-queues and a customer note. Please include account IDs and contact emails.
Emily C: Draft status page message (short):
```
We are investigating an issue affecting usage display and daily invoice generation for a subset of customers in EU. Impact: dashboards may show reduced or 0 usage and daily invoices may be delayed. Engineers are investigating and mitigation is in progress. We'll post updates every 30 minutes.
```

Maria G: suggested public update for status.redwood.ai - include ETA: 60-90 minutes, and note "no charges lost; charges will be accurate after reconciliation."
Alex K: Ops Oncall - current timeline: rollback canary healthy at +4m, no errors on canary, queue depth down 70% on canary node. If green for 10m we'll roll to remaining worker pods.
Ops Oncall: rolling to remaining pods now (controlled rollout).
incident-bot: note: manual customer notification required for tenants with >$1k pending invoices. Use template: 
```
Subject: Notice: Temporary delay in invoice delivery and usage display
Hi <CustomerName>,
We detected an internal issue that may have temporarily affected the display of usage in the Redwood Console and delayed delivery of daily invoices. We have implemented a fix and are reconciling usage and reprocessing invoices. No billing accuracy has been lost; final charges will reflect correct usage. We'll notify you again when processing completes. Sorry for the inconvenience.
If you have time-sensitive billing questions, contact billing@redwood.ai.
```

Lina (Billing): update the template to call out expected resolution window and include dedicated support contact for customers > $50k/mo.
Support-bot: queued an internal thread for support reps with affected account list at https://internal.redwood.ai/threads/5678
Jordan T: after rollout completes, run `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_queue WHERE status='failed'` and then `update invoice_queue set status='pending' where status='failed' and created_at > now() - interval '12 hours'` to re-enqueue. Use controlled batching to avoid stampeding downstream services.
Alex K: rollback completed, monitored for 12m: error rate back to baseline, invoice consumer resumed processing on canary. proceeding with gradual rollout.
Samir P: starting reconciliation job now. Will attach reconciliation report CSV to the internal thread and tag Billing/Lina when ready.
Maria G: Emily, please publish the short status page message now and post the customer template to the support thread. Add an update in 30m even if no change.
Emily C: posted status page and created support thread. https://status.redwood.ai/incident/789 - added Note: "Customers in EU may see delayed invoices and zeroed usage. Engineers have deployed a fix; reconciliation is ongoing."
Ops Oncall: rolling final 4 worker pods now.
incident-bot: Deploy rollout complete.
Ops Oncall: queue depth back to normal, reenqueue job started in controlled batches of 500. Monitoring CPU and DB write latencies.
Lina (Billing): received initial reconciliation report: 178 tenants with missing usage markers, prioritized by invoice size. We'll send targeted emails to top 20 within the hour.
Support-bot: internal status updated, assigned follow-ups to support reps for the affected accounts.
Alex K: closing loop on root cause: a null-check regression introduced in computeUsage in ec9a1f. Patch PR open and merged to main with tests. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/pulls/4521
Jordan T: postmortem items: add preflight validation in consumer to avoid throwing on malformed messages, add canary checks for invoice scheduler, and increase alert granularity for zero-usage spikes.
Emily C: customer-facing follow-up draft: short summary + apology + assurance + link to reconciliation checklist. Lina to approve.
Lina (Billing): approved. send targeted emails, cc support and AMs for the top 20.
Ops Oncall: handing back to Alex K - I'm sticky if anything else pops.
Alex K: thanks - taking over monitoring for next hour.
Maria G: capturing communications for incident report. Please drop any relevant logs/queries into the incident doc.
Samir P: attaching reconciliation CSV to internal thread now.
incident-bot: Incident update posted: mitigated. Status: monitoring.
Alex K: :white_check_mark: Mitigation complete. Will start drafting postmortem and notify SRE/Eng infra for follow-ups.
Emily C: sending final customer-notification for the top 20, and a general message to affected tenants in the next batch.
Lina (Billing): closing billing action items.
Maria G: thanks everyone - nice quick rollback and comms.
Alex K: closing thread, last check-in in 30m. :thumbsup:
